## Retry checklist (run per jurisdiction, at sweep-close or on demand)

1. Confirm current egress actually reaches an external government/regulator host (e.g. `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' <candidate-url>` from the notes above) before assuming the prior block still applies -- environments differ session to session.
2. If reachable: run a normal sweep round for that jurisdiction per `research/coa_fidelity/README.md` (own worktree/branch, `fix(<cc>): verified <N>-code official chart`, PR against `claude/coa-fidelity-sweep`).
3. If still unreachable: leave `fidelity_status: blocked`, but update `last_checked` and append a dated note recording the retry attempt, so repeated retries don't look identical to the first one.
4. Rerun this script (`build_blocked_report.py`) after any STATUS.yaml change so this file stays in sync.
